name: agy-readable
description: Plain-Korean rewrites and translations of Claude Code answers, by agy (Antigravity CLI).

plugins.name: agy-readable
plugins.description: Rebuild Claude's hard-to-read Korean answers into plain, clearly structured Korean with agy, then have Claude (Opus) check the rewrite against the original; answers in other languages are translated into Korean. Code, numbers, paths and links come through unchanged.
